butter.line: It was as if someone had spread butter
butter.linePrev: And circle the blue fields and grease the night
butter.lineNext: On all the fine points of the stars

flutter.line: And the money pile on the dashboard fluttering
stanza: It came over her at a bad time
Riding through Winona down the dotted line
Held us gunning out
90 miles down the road of a dead end dream
She looked over with her part smile
Caught up in the twinkle, it could take awhile
And the money pile on the dashboard fluttering

gutter.line: I heard the song of a poet who died in the gutter
stanza: And what did you hear, my blue-eyed son?
And what did you hear, my darling young one?
I heard the sound of a thunder that roared out a warning
I heard the roar of a wave that could drown the whole world
I heard one hundred drummers whose hands were a-blazing
I heard ten-thousand whispering and nobody listening
I heard one person starve, I heard many people laughing
I heard the song of a poet who died in the gutter
I heard the sound of a clown who cried in the alley

gutter.songTitle: Now That Your Dollar Bills Have Sprouted Wings
gutter.line: Watching all your coins roll down the gutter
stanza: Watching all your coins roll down the gutter
All your champagne going down the sink
Is there something that you're trying to remember?
Or is that string around your finger a wedding ring?

gutter.line: No one ever plans to sleep out in the gutter
stanza: I read the body count out of the paper
And now it’s written all over my face
No one ever plans to sleep out in the gutter
Sometimes that’s just the most comfortable place
